API.build_family_batch: (*, language, base_semantics, marked_semantics, producer, expansion_checker, host_adapter, mined, state, decision, tick, limits=None)
API.injection: marked_semantics is router.point. Caller authenticates full modules and immutable original Source17/input2 authority; no engine/cursor/degree object is accepted.
API.result: {batch,report}; the family_proposer closure returns only batch to current consumer2/engine3.
API.scope: Literal-ground-first: only each miner record full original substitution is tried. All 24 physical rows remain in the finite row universe. Bounded lexicographic row-assignment prefixes and record order are advisory ordering only; no inverse-unification, completeness or absence claim.

batch.instances: Exactly ordinary seven-field registry/family_id/host/substitution/port_bindings/proposal/row_assignment. Each offered instance freshly expanded, independently checked and natively adapted; no partial instance. UNKNOWN has instances[].

census: Current selected/excluded plus every exposed original/decorated prototype is compared by full type preimage; alternative point unions remain separate. Engine3 must still compare against its own observed census.

physical_sources.origin: Miner/collector source metadata is retained only as opaque origin. Actual current original selected full key or null, row and occupancy replace it.

rejections: Only actual strict-prior, physical sharing, capacity/excluded-key and full mark disagreement reject the current row assignment. No branch exclusion is installed and no descriptor/native failure is caught as a learned negative. Native, callback, data, malformed and collision errors propagate. Own bounded work can return a completed advisory prefix only.
row_policy: For each fully checked ground expansion, anchor each primitive node in expansion order at actual supplied BRANCH row; input rows then topological node rows in ascending physical order, with strict-prior propagation and exact mark/share/point checks. No target literal selection or engine decision supplied by provider.
